steps.text: The "Representations" tab lists the community members you represent. Click a row to open its record.
steps.title: Your memberships

steps.text: The "Meters" tab lists the meters attached to the members you represent. Click a row to inspect a meter in detail.
steps.title: Your meters

steps.text: Click the meter's row to consult its detail and its readings.
steps.title: Open your meter

steps.text: Tap the meter's row to consult its detail and its readings.
steps.title: Open your meter

steps.text: The meter view shows its characteristics and status. The tabs let you see the current configuration, history, upcoming periods, and consumption.
steps.title: Your meter

steps.text: The "Consumption" tab presents your meter's readings. When no data is available yet, a message tells you so.
steps.title: Consumption
